analysis.title: GS Early Morning Research Recap: Ratings and Target Price Changes - November 20, 2026 as of 5:30 AM ET
key_insights: Rating changes in this edition: Stewart Information Services (STC) initiated at Neutral with a $49 price target. Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico (GAPB.MX and PAC) cut from Buy to Sell. Var Energi (VAR.OL) cut from Buy to Neutral.
Latin America airports: GS moves Pacifico to Sell and keeps Buy on ASUR and OMA. The PAC target falls to $231 from $263, only 2% above the $225.9 last price. The ASR target rises to $360 from $323.

Var Energi was cut because GS now builds a long-term bearish gas view into its estimates, citing Qatari LNG exports edging up. The target falls to 51 Nkr from 70 Nkr, and the note's table shows 7% upside.
Other 10%+ target changes in Europe: Harbour Energy (Buy) to 320p from 360p, Ithaca Energy (Neutral) to 250p from 280p, Advanced Petrochemical (Neutral) to SR24.80 from SR22.40.

US power: NRG Energy (Buy) target cut to $149 from $167, still 59% above the $93.85 last price. GS Utilities is updating IPP estimates after earnings and elections and prefers PJM over ERCOT in the near term.

Midstream and energy: Hess Midstream (Sell) target cut to $29 from $33. The 3Q26 recap calls it a quiet update after the CVX restructuring and says GS is waiting for guidance and further disclosures. TC Energy (Buy) NDR takeaways say Canada growth is accelerating and complements US gas growth.

Retail earnings: Ross Stores F3Q26 shows strong share gains continuing (Buy). Walmart share gains continued across categories, supported by price investment, and FY26 guidance was raised. Dick's reports promotional breadth and depth at Foot Locker rising sequentially.

Retail weakness: Gap FY26 outlook reduced on a softer start to holiday, though Old Navy shows sequential progress. Williams-Sonoma had a 3Q26 top-line miss, and freight will raise costs and shipping delays. Bath & Body Works trends remain pressured, with tariffs and oil costs weighing on 4Q gross margins.
Procter & Gamble Investor Day: GS says it highlighted superiority, targeted interventions and productivity as the key opportunities.
Valvoline 4Q26 was in line, the FY27 outlook was better than feared, and repurchases will resume. Elanco announced an inaugural share buyback program.

China internet: Alibaba 2QFY27 shows an AI Cloud growth downward reset but a clearer path to FCF inflection, and GS maintains Buy. PDD 3Q26 shows ad revenue re-acceleration (Buy). Kuaishou ads weakness is expected to persist with limited visibility into 2027E (Neutral, target cut to HK$29 from HK$34). NetEase grossing is slower near term but remains defensive (Buy).
China Semis note: AI and local-for-local beneficiaries. The Mutual Fundamentals note says mutual funds remain selective within the AI complex.

Technology: Keysight 4QFY26 wrap shows record orders with strong growth drivers for FY27 and beyond. Warner Music FY4Q26 was a broad-based beat that achieved FY26 targets, and estimates were raised on the F2027 outlook. Americas Communications Technology bus tour covers 650 Group, ANET, CSCO and SMCI.
Asia Pacific Banks: GS maps ASEAN data-center exposure and calls the credit risk manageable while watching growth implications.
Japan Tobacco announced deconsolidation of its Russian business and a dividend cut, but GS says the profit growth outlook is better than expected.
Korea insurers: target changes of 10% or more for Samsung F&M (Buy), to W760,000 from W870,000, and Hyundai M&F (Neutral), to W42,000 from W51,000.
Strategy and commodities items listed: Japan Weekly Kickstart 2027 Outlook, 2027 US Equity Outlook presentation (The Beginning of the Middle), and the Global Commodities Outlook 2027 replay.
Economics: the CEEMEA Economics Analyst on CEE-3 inflation says there is less domestic pressure and more external pressure.

earnings_insights: Ross Stores F3Q26 earnings review: strong share gains continue (no figures in this recap).
Walmart: share gains continued across categories, supported by price investment, and FY26 guidance was raised.
Gap F3Q26: Old Navy shows sequential progress, but a softer start to holiday drives a reduced FY26 outlook.
Williams-Sonoma 3Q26: top-line miss as management increases full-price selling initiatives. Freight will raise costs and shipping delays.
Bath & Body Works 3Q26 recap: underlying trends remain pressured, and tariffs and oil costs will weigh on 4Q gross margins.
Valvoline 4Q26: results in line, FY27 outlook better than feared, repurchases to resume.
Warner Music FY4Q26: broad-based beat on results and FY26 targets achieved. Estimates were raised on the F2027 outlook, reflecting solid subscription streaming growth and cost execution.
Keysight 4QFY26 wrap: record orders with strong growth drivers for FY27 and beyond.
Alibaba 2QFY27: AI Cloud growth downward reset with a clearer path to FCF inflection.
PDD 3Q26: ad revenue re-acceleration with continued supply chain and merchant ecosystem investments.
Kuaishou 3Q26: ads weakness to persist, with limited visibility into 2027E.
NetEase 3Q26: near-term grossing slower, defensive play with a new blockbuster title approaching.
Full Truck Alliance 3Q26: healthy trucker commission growth with a double-digit 4Q volume outlook.
Futu: cost discipline and resilient interest income in focus.
Vallourec 3Q in line, but Middle East disruption pushes out the 4Q recovery.
Elior FY26: EBITA in line but weaker FCF and leverage.
Japan Tobacco: deconsolidation of the Russian business and a dividend cut, but profit growth outlook better than expected.
Sims 2026 AGM: memory chip 1H FY27 guidance upgraded on service fees, group EBIT guidance in line.

Midstream 3Q26 recaps: Plains All American broadening growth outlook, LandBridge adding first data center revenue to its model, WaterBridge strong growth outlook affirmed and still a top smid-cap idea.
risk_factors: Tariffs and oil costs weigh on Bath & Body Works 4Q gross margins.

Softer start to the holiday season led Gap to reduce its FY26 outlook.
Rising Qatari LNG exports pressure the long-term gas outlook for European E&Ps.
Middle East disruption delays Vallourec's 4Q recovery and weighs on Globant demand.
AI Cloud growth reset at Alibaba and ads weakness at Kuaishou.
ASEAN data-center exposure for Asia Pacific banks, which GS calls a manageable credit risk.
